description: Fetches information from Hiroshima Peace Memorial Museum (hpmmuseum.jp) including visiting information, virtual museum exhibits, and exhibition details in multiple languages.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_info_page: 获取博物馆信息页面（参观、交通、导览服务等）; 参数: page_id, lang; 必填: page_id
  - get_exhibit_page: 获取虚拟博物馆展览页面内容; 参数: exhibit_id, page_num, lang; 必填: exhibit_id, page_num
  - get_exhibit_toc: 获取展览目录/章节列表; 参数: exhibit_id, lang; 必填: exhibit_id
  - get_permanent_exhibitions: 获取常设展信息; 参数: lang; 必填: 无
  - get_homepage: 获取主页导航信息; 参数: lang; 必填: 无

page_id.description:
信息页面ID，用于get_info_page。
常用ID: 42(参观), 154(交通), 52(导览服务), 174(楼层图), 
        155(博物馆商店), 63(图书馆), 177(在线证言), 163(学习和平)

lang.description:
语言代码。支持: eng(英语), jpn(日语), fre(法语), ger(德语), 
ita(意大利语), spa(西班牙语), zho(中文)

exhibit_id.description:
展览ID，用于get_exhibit_page和get_exhibit_toc。
例如: "1302" ( Memories of You展览)

page_num.description:
展览页面编号，用于get_exhibit_page。
两位数字符串，如 "00"(介绍), "01", "06", "11"(结语)
